name: Zoom
description: Zoom meetings: list upcoming, details, recordings, and schedule new ones.
help: FASTEST: paste the Client ID + secret below, press Connect and approve in the browser. ALTERNATIVE (no browser): create a Server-to-Server OAuth app at marketplace.zoom.us > Develop > Build App and paste the Client ID, secret and Account ID. Tokens refresh themselves.

fields.label: Account ID (only for Server-to-Server, blank when using Connect)
